title: Logo Contest
metaDescription: Help create Almondyoung's new logo. Submit your design and vote for your favorite.
headline:
Help create
Almondyoung's new logo
lead: Submit a logo and vote for your favorite. The entry with the most votes becomes Almondyoung's new logo.

help.votes: Shows the top 4 entries by votes, among entries with at least one vote.
help.tie: When votes are tied, the entry submitted first ranks higher.
help.refresh: While you're on this page, the ranking updates every 30 seconds.

form.agreeLabel: I agree to all of the following.
form.agreeTerms:
My entry is my own work and does not infringe anyone else's rights.
If it wins, I transfer the copyright (including the right to create derivative works) to Almondyoung.
If selected as a winner, I must email the original source files for the logo and symbol to the address provided by Almondyoung.
Awards are revoked if plagiarism is found.
Work made with AI tools may be entered, provided the tool's terms allow commercial use and transfer of rights.
